items.text: Dear Junkers! 🔧😄
This update focuses heavily on two important areas of Junkyard Simulator: the save system and restoration gameplay.

Based on your feedback, we've completely reworked how autosaves are handled to make starting new games safer, separate progress between Story and Sandbox modes, and significantly reduce the risk of accidentally losing previous progress.

We've also introduced a brand-new Free Cursor Mode for Restoration, designed especially for players who found restoring objects or vehicles difficult or uncomfortable while controlling everything directly from the first-person camera.
On top of that, we've improved restoration progress calculations and fixed several objects that could cause problems during the restoration process.
As always, thank you for your reports, suggestions, and feedback. Many of these changes were made directly because of issues and ideas shared by the community. ❤️
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/bb3146f2d9a7d13aafaad0151c378483c8fb7461.jpg"]
Reworked the Autosave System to provide much safer handling of player progress across multiple playthroughs.
Starting a New Game will no longer overwrite autosaves from your previous playthrough, preventing players from accidentally losing existing progress when creating a new game.
Added support for an unlimited number of autosaves, allowing players to continue playing without worrying about newer autosaves replacing important progress from previous sessions.
Autosaves are now handled individually instead of being limited to a small shared pool of save slots.
Completely separated Story Mode and Sandbox Mode autosaves.
Story Mode now maintains its own autosaves, independent from Sandbox Mode.
Sandbox Mode now maintains its own autosaves, independent from Story Mode.
Switching between Story and Sandbox will therefore no longer mix or interfere with autosaves created in the other game mode.
Improved save organization to make managing multiple playthroughs safer and more predictable.
Added additional protection for existing save files created before this update.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/305c2382b47eed38d4ab132c4f22e99ad4ec8a9d.jpg"]
The new save system has been designed to preserve existing player progress during the transition, so players can continue their current playthroughs after updating the game.
Improved compatibility between existing saves and the newly reworked autosave structure.
Overall, the save system should now be significantly safer for players who maintain multiple playthroughs, experiment with Sandbox Mode, or regularly start new games.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/a1b7a905e84771244b7325a8813599cdf8cb03b2.jpg"]
Added a completely new Free Cursor Mode for restoration.
This feature was introduced directly in response to feedback from players who experienced difficulties restoring objects while using the traditional first-person camera controls.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/1d034c4729342d6db80338bdd774f7f4d22d6b6a.jpg"]
Free Cursor Mode allows restoration to be performed directly with the mouse cursor, without requiring the player to constantly rotate the camera while working on an object.
Players can now interact with restoration surfaces in a more controlled and precise way, making it easier to reach specific areas of an object.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/7d998457b3740856f10f52b3fd77ebb8ed4ecfdf.jpg"]
The new mode provides an alternative way to perform restoration while keeping the existing restoration gameplay available.
This should make restoration more comfortable for players who prefer direct mouse interaction instead of camera-based aiming.
Free Cursor Mode is especially useful when working on larger objects or when trying to reach smaller areas that previously required constant camera adjustments.
The goal is to make restoration feel more accessible, comfortable, and precise without changing the core restoration mechanics.
Added Free Cursor Mode to vehicle restoration.
Vehicles can now be restored using the same cursor-based interaction system introduced for other restoration activities.
Players no longer need to rely exclusively on first-person camera movement when working on vehicle surfaces.
Improved interaction with different sections of restored vehicles, especially when working around larger body panels and harder-to-reach areas.
This should make longer vehicle restoration sessions significantly more comfortable and easier to control.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/25f2a8008853ce9e7ea095c4eedcfe211077af06.jpg"]
Reworked the way restoration progress percentage is calculated.
Restoration progress should now more accurately represent how much of an object has actually been restored.
Fixed situations where an object could incorrectly reach 100% restoration while a significant part of it was still unfinished.
Fixed cases where restoration could sometimes be completed after restoring only approximately half of an object.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/d6def2443472e4cadaef3281d65905b8af07a90b.jpg"]
Fixed situations where restoring only one side of an object could incorrectly provide enough progress to complete the entire restoration.
Improved surface coverage calculations so restoration progress better reflects the actual amount of work completed.
Restoration percentages should now increase in a more predictable and consistent way while working across different parts of an object.
Improved detection of restored and unrestored areas to reduce incorrect completion results.
The system should now require more complete coverage of the object before considering the restoration finished.
These changes should make the restoration process feel more logical and make reaching 100% better reflect the actual visual state of the restored item.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/2841dd8eeb52446773714f3dd5f29a81f5a37ef4.jpg"]
Fixed several objects that could cause problems during the restoration process.
Improved restoration behavior on objects where certain areas were difficult or impossible to properly restore.
Adjusted problematic restoration surfaces that could previously result in inconsistent progress calculations.
Improved interaction detection on selected restoration objects.
Fixed additional cases where individual parts of an object could behave incorrectly during cleaning or restoration.
Applied additional improvements to restoration object setup to make the system more consistent across different types of items and vehicles.
Improved the overall reliability of progression saving during normal gameplay.
Improved separation between different game modes and playthroughs.
Reduced the possibility of accidentally losing previous progress when starting another game.
Made long-term progression safer for players maintaining multiple saves.
Improved restoration accessibility by providing an alternative control method.
Improved restoration precision for both regular objects and vehicles.
Improved the consistency between the visual restoration state of an object and its displayed completion percentage.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/30183bf8978a2de7d196d6d5835f385d592295e0.jpg"]
Fixed multiple issues related to restoration completion detection.
Fixed incorrect restoration percentage calculations on selected objects.
Fixed several problematic restoration surfaces and interaction areas.
Improved compatibility of existing saves with the updated save system.
Applied additional stability improvements to save handling.
Applied additional quality-of-life improvements based directly on community reports and suggestions.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/e7c3895064fbc4323da992e6931b32dccc3601a0.jpg"]
A large part of this update comes directly from your feedback.
The new Free Cursor Restoration Mode was created because some players told us that restoring objects through first-person camera movement could sometimes be uncomfortable or difficult.

The Save System overhaul was also an important step toward making Junkyard Simulator safer for longer playthroughs, especially for players switching between Story and Sandbox or starting additional games.

Junkyard Simulator is still actively being developed, and there are many more updates, improvements, fixes, and new content ahead. We're continuing to work on both existing systems and completely new features that will expand the game further.
Thank you for playing, reporting issues, sharing your ideas, and helping us improve Junkyard Simulator! ❤️
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/86a0e58369d20e67ce34e81ad866d3b9f904a173.jpg"]

This update includes one of the largest technical overhauls in the game's history. Major systems responsible for restoration, weather simulation, environmental rendering, world streaming, and performance management have been reworked and optimized to deliver a smoother, more immersive experience for all players.
As always, thank you for your feedback and continued support. More content, features, and improvements are already in development.
I would like to share an important update regarding the future of the game. Over the coming months, update frequency will likely slow down significantly.

This is because I have started work on a major redesign of several core gameplay systems, including the game's opening experience, player progression, and a number of fundamental mechanics that have been part of the game for a long time.

As the project has grown over the years, it has become increasingly clear that some systems need more than incremental improvements. To take the game where I want it to be, I need to step back and rebuild certain foundations properly rather than continue patching and expanding old solutions.

This means that development will be focused less on frequent content updates and more on large-scale restructuring behind the scenes. As a result, there may be periods of several months without major public updates.

I know this may be disappointing for some players, and I sincerely apologize for the longer wait. However, I firmly believe that these changes are necessary for the long-term future of the game and will ultimately result in a much better experience for both new and existing players.
In many ways, parts of the game need to be rebuilt almost from scratch. It is a significant undertaking, but it is the right step forward.

Thank you for your patience, support, feedback, and trust throughout this journey. The game is not being abandoned — quite the opposite. The work happening now is aimed at building a stronger foundation for everything that comes next.
See you in the next major chapter of development.

just released a small hotfix focused on improving texture quality and stability on lower-end hardware.🚀
Fixed an issue where textures could appear blurry or low-resolution after the latest update
Improved texture streaming behavior to better adapt to available GPU memory
Reduced aggressive mip downscaling on systems with limited VRAM
Overall more stable visual quality across different hardware configurations
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/d69e7f14c2816c38d259a1c7b3b54c6772e2feec.png"]
This issue mainly impacted players using GPUs with 4 GB of VRAM or less, such as:
NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (4GB)
Older AMD cards with similar memory limits
We’ve adjusted how the game handles texture memory allocation.
Previously, a fixed memory pool could cause unintended texture downgrades on lower-end GPUs.
The system now scales more dynamically based on available hardware, resulting in more consistent visuals.
@DM-Stealth, @EREN YAZICI (43)
Thank you for your reports and patience — they helped us quickly identify and resolve the issue.

items.text: Hey, Junkers!🔧😄

It’s time for another big wave of improvements! This update brings you a completely revamped tutorial that guides new players in a much more intuitive and accessible way. Thanks to this, your start in the world of scrap will be easier, clearer, and — most importantly — more enjoyable! 🚗
But that’s not all! This update also delivers a solid batch of quality-of-life improvements and optimization upgrades that should noticeably boost the game’s performance on most devices. 🔧
I reorganized background processes, optimized the logic behind several systems, and fixed a number of issues you reported over the past weeks.
Thank you for every report — your feedback constantly pushes the game forward! 💛
And this is only the beginning of the bigger changes I’m already preparing for you.
Check out the full patch notes! 📋🚀

The tutorial and its overhaul are a huge change in the game, because now, whenever you encounter a problem, you can simply press T and the tutorial will adjust to the action you’re currently performing.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/bd5100c5bab16975f1837ff07eff836f46594a79.jpg"]
You no longer need to browse through a long list to find a specific mechanic, nor scroll through multiple videos to locate the one you’re looking for.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/67def4a1c219fa04adbfecb7415b7ac151b4226f.jpg"]
Now, while using any mechanic, you can press T, and you’ll instantly get all the key elements of that mechanic — with clear descriptions and step-by-step instructions on how to perform each action.
You can also freely rebind this input to make it more convenient for you. We will continue adding new mechanics to the tutorial so it always remains fast, helpful, and easy to use.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/4829e70bbf983103854123c760941bcddb54faa8.jpg"]

We’ve optimized the game — and yes, we’re doing it constantly. This is an ongoing process that we’ll continue right up until the full release. We see a lot of potential both in improving area loading and enhancing the rendering engine.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/a68c6d1293531612dfa8ae2e6e68d937f196ae92.jpg"]PERFORMANCE settings
Spec: Resolution: 1920x1080 / Graphics Card: GTX 1070 / RAM: 32GB / Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 CPU @ 3.60GHz

You can already notice a significant difference in shadow rendering, post-processing, lighting, as well as overall image sharpness and grain. I’ve also eliminated the issue with “dark shadows,” which could occur when selecting the lowest graphics settings.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/324876b17bfd829722248201e9e392fc705b2540.jpg"]PERFORMANCE settings
Spec: Resolution: 1920x1080 / Graphics Card: GTX 1070 / RAM: 32GB / Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 CPU @ 3.60GHz

In the previous version, choosing that preset would accidentally disable global illumination. Now, global illumination works across all settings, and its optimization on the lowest preset has resulted in a 12 FPS increase. This means that even players with weaker PCs should now enjoy smoother gameplay.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/b49b55c6b202394489fff4b336f016caed62a58a.jpg"]PERFORMANCE settings
Spec: Resolution: 1920x1080 / Graphics Card: GTX 1070 / RAM: 32GB / Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 CPU @ 3.60GHz

I recommend trying the preset graphics options — they’re carefully balanced between visual quality and performance cost. Right after the New Year, I’ll release another optimization update that will further improve performance around the viaduct and during location loading.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/952d3f4f17cfbc5892eab35554d954cfecaa11fb.jpg"]PERFORMANCE settings
Spec: Resolution: 1920x1080 / Graphics Card: GTX 1070 / RAM: 32GB / Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 CPU @ 3.60GHz
• Introduced a new, user-friendly tutorial system. From now on, you can press the T key at any moment to display a hint tailored to your current situation or the mechanic you’re using.

• Improved wreck indicators in Quests. During the Wreck Searching task, only icons related to the active Quest will be shown. After delivering the quest-required wrecks to the unloading zone, all other wrecks return to their normal visibility.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/050c4cae1fc4528349d79a9a9b0392bc6c67db8b.jpg"]
• Fixed an issue where completing the Vehicle Inspection task by not moving prevented the informational widget about vehicle restoration from appearing.

• Resolved a problem where completing the Vehicle Inspection task by staying in place caused the vehicle-highlighting system to malfunction, leaving vehicles visible and potentially misleading players into thinking they already owned them.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/4d812aa782ceb42f5a57c4053b039ab12b48075f.jpg"]

items.text: Hey Junkers! 🎮⚙️

items.text: Hey Junkers! 🎮⚙️
At your request, I’ve just added new stamina options! 💪
From now on, you can extend stamina by +1h, +2h, or +3h — and yes, there’s also an option to turn stamina off completely ( MENU > OPTIONS > GRAPHICS/GAMEPLAY ) .
Now, I’ll be honest with you — I still believe that the fridge system, shopping, and refueling are all perfectly balanced around the 1-hour stamina cycle.
But since you’re my wonderful community ❤️ and I truly appreciate all your support for my game, I decided to add these options so you can test and choose what feels best for you.
👉 Personally, I recommend the 1-2-hour stamina — it already feels quite long.

For the more impatient ones, 3 hours are available too, and of course, the “no stamina” option as well. Just remember — with stamina turned off, your character will always stay at 100%, so there’ll be no need for shopping anymore. 😄
Thank you all so much for your feedback and constant support — it really means the world to me and keeps me motivated to keep improving the game week by week! 🙏
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/5680c55d1e83397cdb5da526283f972991abdc75.jpg"]

Added an option to disable the Progress Bar Minigame. You can now turn this feature off in the Options menu. When disabled:
No need to press the RMB combo while using tools.
You can load vehicles onto the tow truck without using the hook minigame.
Added a new option in Game Settings to pause stamina depletion, allowing you to play without needing to eat.
Added stamina duration adjustment. You can now control how long it takes for stamina to drop from 100% to 0%.
🎵 Audio
Fixed missing ambient music in Sandbox Mode.
Restored ambient music for players in Story Mode who previously didn’t have background music playing.
🖱️ Controls & Keybindings
Fixed an issue where default keybindings (Radial Menu, Crouch, Vehicle Reset, Tablet) were still active even after assigning custom keys — preventing both keys from triggering the same action.
🚗 Vehicles & Tasks
Adjusted the hangar viewing task so it now completes even if the player remains in place after being teleported to the location.
Relocated the Diamond and Gold Bar inside the Blue Car to easier-to-find positions, preventing situations where players couldn’t locate them before full disassembly.
Improved the tow truck loading task — other vehicles will no longer appear, preventing confusion about the quest’s correct target.
🏪 Shops & Interactions
Blocked the ability to exit during the animation and summary phase of a successful shop payment, ensuring proper transaction completion.

Disabled access to the Large Map during the renovation of the Blue Car and Pickup 1950 to avoid unintended interactions.

releases.displayName: Tow truck mechanics evolution and fuel station update!

items.text: Hey, Junkers! 🚨🚚
Time for another big step forward! This week’s update brings major improvements to tow truck mechanics and introduces a fully working fuel station! ⛽🔧

We’ve fine-tuned how the tow truck handles, making it smoother, more realistic, and way more fun to use. Plus, the fuel system is now live — giving you one more reason to keep your vehicles in shape and ready to roll! ⚙️
As always, your feedback keeps us going! Drop us a review or let us know what you think — your ideas help shape the future of the game.
We’ve also fixed many of the bugs you reported — thank you for all your feedback!
Check out the full patch notes for details. 📋
You can now enjoy greater precision and an all-new system for loading vehicles onto the tow truck!

🛠️ Added the ability to close the confirmation message about enabling the loader using the ESC key on the keyboard and the corresponding button on the gamepad. This allows for emergency closure of the message and provides a more convenient option for players who prefer using ESC.

🛠️ A new feature has been introduced allowing players to close the message about vehicle wreck reset or processed scrap cube in the loader using the ESC key and the corresponding gamepad button. 🛠️ Interaction with the wreck unloading panel no longer requires directly looking at it. The unloading panel’s functionality has been changed to allow activation by simply approaching it, without the need to aim the camera directly at it. This change greatly improves the experience for players using lower-end PCs, where there were previously issues with interacting using the key.

🛠️ Bug fix for the “Fast Travel” quest – first wreck. Fixed an issue that prevented the use of the loader during the “Fast Travel” quest when the player was transporting the first wreck onto the tow track as part of the unloading panel task. The loader now functions correctly regardless of the quest stage.

🛠️ Fixed a loading screen freeze on the your junkyard lot. Addressed a case that caused the game to freeze during the loading screen while entering the your junkyard lot for some players.
🛠️ We have optimized certain gameplay mechanics in terms of memory usage, resulting in improved performance, especially on lower-end PCs.

🛠️ Fix – after selecting PERFORMANCE, the game enables V-Sync, which shouldn't happen, as many players need to play without it.

releases.displayName: Quests and tutorial changes - Big Update!

items.text: Hey, as you know, we are constantly working on the game. Update 2.2.3 includes big changes to the quests and tutorial - Just like asked/requested.
It is shorter and more specific. Of course, we ask for feedback! ːsteamhappyː
Below is also a list of fixes that the update contains.
Better story quest flow
Speed ​​up string loading when throwing boxes (plot) by 30-40%

Get rid of these subtasks from Quest so the bug is "fixed": BUG: Quest 8 - 6/7 - Clean armchair and put down brush. - So I got the brush via pressing ALT and selecting it instead of picking up the brush in the world. I've sold the chair to the guy so now the mission is locked at "clean armchair and put down brush" - Great.
Add a block on the ability to purchase vehicle auto renovation skills and items until it causes a blocker (i.e. after the blue vehicle quest). Players reported the problem.
Adding Hud to vehicles - several players did not know how to turn on the lights of a car/stroller, rooster, etc..
Changing the button for hints when searching and dismantling the challenger from i to H
Fixed an error where, after loading the game and the player has a delivery on the Lot, instead of seeing a list of items, a counter for the next delivery is shown
Unlocking the ability to sell in the Pawnshop after completing the task of delivering a chair and wine to Grandma

Fixed a bug that made it possible to obtain a duplicate car when we had a vehicle pulled to the lift and were pulling another vehicle from the tow truck to replace it
Repair of endless sound and thus blocking of the crane raising or lowering during vehicle renovation

Fixed misleading information regarding lot condition and lot cleanliness bonuses
Add additional security to completing the quest with a fast trip to the scrapyard

Securing a possible blocker while we need to talk to Grandma and she will leave the quest area

Fixed the collision of pawnshop items that were flying through the container floor

Now the order is as follows: Quest 8 - Using stationary press: Quest 9 - Win the Old Lady's trust - she runs an illegal pawnshop: Quest 10 - Fast Travel: Quest 11 - Find abandoned camp upon Lucy's instructions: Quest 12 - At the end of one of the sections: Quest 13 - Felix recommends buying a container

notes.title: Added new Delivery mechanics for Lots

items.text: The Delivery Area is a new section of the Lot available to the player who has completed 100% of all lots to have an order loop.
Deliveries involve receiving Items, Vehicles or Structures for processing using tools
Players receive the next delivery after 30 minutes when they finish processing the currently placed Items, Vehicles and Structures in the Delivery Area
The Delivery Area will allow you to expand your plot to 100%, thanks to the endless supply of raw materials that can be obtained.
Adding the Lost and Found Office
This is a special stand next to the Pawn Shop, where we can recover valuable items when they fall into the ground while exploring the game world.
